낮에는 수영장 있는 호텔에서 푹 쉬고, 저녁에는 강변에서 식사하거나 루프: Rest at a hotel with a pool during the day, then enjoy riverside dining or rooftop night views in the evening. Bangkok suits a trip combining time at a five-star hotel with city sightseeing.
올드시티의 사원과 골목을 걷다가 마음에 드는 카페에 들러보세요. 커피 한: Walk past temples and through Old City lanes, stopping at a café that catches your eye. Choose Chiang Mai for unhurried days with coffee and neighbourhood walks.
하얀 사원과 푸른 사원처럼 색과 모양이 특별한 건축물을 만나보세요. 사진: See the distinctive colours and shapes of the White Temple and Blue Temple. Visit the buildings you have seen in photographs and explore northern Thailand’s mountains and temples.
낮에는 해변을 산책하거나 호텔에서 쉬고, 저녁에는 바다를 바라보며 식사해: Walk along the beach or rest at your hotel during the day, then have dinner looking out to sea. Combine a seaside holiday with places to eat and explore in town.
가족과 바닷가 숙소에 머물며 아침에는 해변을 걷고, 저녁에는 시장을 둘러: Stay by the sea with your family, walk along the beach in the morning and visit markets in the evening. Choose Hua Hin for shared meals and rest without a packed sightseeing schedule.
리조트에서 바다를 보며 쉬는 날과 올드타운을 둘러보는 날을 나누어 계획해: Give sea-view resort days and Old Town outings separate space in your trip. Enjoy a beach holiday as well as walks and meals among streets of colourful buildings.
바다 옆으로 우뚝 솟은 석회암 절벽을 바라보며 해변을 걸어보세요. 바닷가: Walk along beaches beneath limestone cliffs rising beside the sea. Alternate restful days by the shore with boat outings to islands for different ways to enjoy the coast.
바닷가 리조트에 머물며 늦은 아침을 먹고, 해변을 산책하다 숙소로 돌아와: Enjoy a late breakfast at a seaside resort, walk along the beach and return for a rest. Take time over meals and relaxation with your partner or family.
바다 위로 솟은 절벽과 섬 사이로 펼쳐지는 풍경을 만나보세요. 배를 타고: See cliffs rising from the sea and views between the islands. Explore by boat or look out from a viewpoint to experience the Thai island scenery you have seen in photographs.
해변에서 쉬는 휴가와 음악을 즐기는 밤을 모두 생각하고 있다면 코팡안을: Consider Koh Phangan for beach relaxation and nights with music. Choose your beach and travel dates for either a lively atmosphere or a quieter break.
해변 풍경뿐 아니라 물속 풍경도 궁금하시다면 코타오로 떠나보세요. 스노클: If you are curious about the underwater scenery as well as the beaches, consider Koh Tao. Learn to snorkel or dive, then finish the day relaxing beside the sea.
바닷가 숙소에서 책을 읽고, 해 질 무렵에는 해변을 따라 걸어보세요. 매: Read at accommodation by the sea and walk along the beach as the sun sets. Choose Koh Lanta if you would rather stay longer on a beach you like than seek a new attraction every day.
방콕 여행에 짧은 바다 휴가를 더하고 싶다면 코사멧을 살펴보세요. 하얀: Add a short seaside break to a Bangkok trip. Walk along white sand and eat by the sea, leaving time to rest after exploring the city.
좋은 호텔에서 푹 쉬고 싶은지, 사원과 카페를 천천히 둘러보고 싶은지,: Imagine the days you would like to spend in Thailand: relaxing at a comfortable hotel, walking between temples and cafés, or taking a seaside holiday. Explore the cities and islands below and choose places that suit the way you want to travel.
